title: Language Model Interfaces
summary: This module defines the core interfaces and base classes for interacting with various language models (LLMs) and chat models, providing a consistent abstraction layer for different providers and model types.

nodes.label: Base Language Models
nodes.title: Base Language Models
nodes.description: Defines the foundational interfaces for interacting with various language models, including abstract base classes for LLMs and chat models, enabling consistent integration and extensibility.

nodes.label: Fake Language Models
nodes.title: Fake Language Models
nodes.description: Provides various fake chat model implementations for testing and development purposes, simulating different response behaviors without external API calls.

nodes.label: Message Handling
nodes.title: Message Handling
nodes.description: Provides utilities for handling and translating messages, including content block creation, message filtering, merging, and history management. It supports various LLM provider-specific message formats.

nodes.label: Partner LLM Integrations
nodes.title: Partner LLM Integrations
nodes.description: Provides interfaces and utilities for integrating with various partner-specific Large Language Models (LLMs), including Anthropic, Groq, HuggingFace, Mistral AI, Ollama, and OpenAI, handling message conversion, tool calling, and prompt caching.

groups.label: Core Abstractions
groups.title: Core Abstractions
groups.description: These components define the fundamental interfaces and message structures that all language models and chat models adhere to, ensuring consistency across different implementations.

groups.label: Model Implementations
groups.title: Model Implementations
groups.description: This group includes concrete implementations of language models, ranging from fake models for testing to integrations with various third-party LLM providers.
